meta.title: Benton County — the money trail
meta.note: This is Benton County's 2026 budget, adopted by Appropriation Ordinance O-2025-55 in November 2025. We use Schedule 2, which lists each office's 2026 budget by category, and it adds up to the printed all-funds total of $123,800,625. The county also plans $7,348,377 in transfers out of the General Fund to other county funds (Schedule 3); the receiving funds spend that money, and the transfers are not counted a second time here.
